_about: scripts/family_exec.py: under-canopy checks planned on synthetic 3D maps of generated worlds and flown in a real-world draw (forward depth camera, camera navigation, 5 m/s wind). 12 worlds x 8 spots per family. under_p: the real hamlet site's measured 0.25, scaled by each family's 3D reach relative to generated wilderness (synthetic forest is more open than the lidar forest); under_p_3d: the 3D reach itself.
